notes.topic: separate merge and deploy confirmations
notes.correction: Treat merge and prod daemon restart as separate gates: after merge stop, re-verify live state fresh, and wait for a distinct 'yes' before restarting.

notes.topic: never bypass launchpad freshen refusal
notes.correction: Do not git pull on a dirty launchpad; after any pull check stash list for autostash, restore with apply not pop, and deploy via checkout of merge commit.

notes.topic: use signal timeout method under xdist
notes.correction: Use pytest-timeout --timeout-method=signal with xdist; treat 'node down' as a timeout and compare passed-test counts against a known-full run before calling green.

notes.topic: quote untrusted text for model readers
notes.correction: Line-prefix every body line and defang marker-shaped text with a tolerant regex; use \Z not $; prefer structurally impossible designs over sanitizing harder.

notes.topic: symmetric liveness check in race validation
notes.correction: Apply the same release-liveness predicate to your own claim and the foreign one, and branch explicitly when your own claim was voided mid-flight.

notes.topic: measure defect density before building checkers
notes.correction: Sweep for real instances of a defect class before building its checker; defer zero-instance classes, and report sweep limits rather than claiming audited clean.

notes.topic: capture peer job logs before cleanup
notes.correction: Reap helpers must read or copy a peer job's out.log and events into the run dir and classify the failure before deleting the job directory.

notes.topic: reconcile contradicting subagent reports first
notes.correction: When subagents disagree on a fact, resolve it before acting; suspect a stale checkout, ask where each read, and use git show origin/main explicitly.
notes.enforcer_named: `rent-check inventory` now reports a `checkout` record first (dotfiles#365) and `--strict` exits 1 on stale

notes.topic: scope reconciler convergence to delivery
notes.correction: Define reconciler 'converged' as existence of the delivered artifact, not payload-hash equality, and enforce it at the storage layer; don't read gap counts as ground truth.
notes.enforcer_named: the claim RPCs themselves refuse a row that is already announced-with-a-message-id

notes.topic: red CI hides later steps
notes.correction: When a single-job workflow goes red, run the skipped later suites locally before pushing the fix; never report green from a truncated run.
notes.repeat_signal: every prior CI run had truncated at the same place

notes.topic: read test summary before diagnosing red
notes.correction: Before diagnosing a red CI job, read the runner's own summary and gate error text; a retry-recovered pass promoted by a zero-flake gate is policy, not a bug.

notes.topic: prove refactor kept test coverage
notes.correction: Before committing a test-helper refactor, diff pre/post def names with comm -23 in both directions to mechanically prove coverage was not narrowed.

notes.topic: diagnostics must print scope searched
notes.correction: Every sweep or scan must print its roots and candidate count at start and in summary; write a check instead of an issue for re-derivable follow-ups.

notes.topic: gate review findings at filing time
notes.correction: Gate findings through a judge before filing issues, run adversarial-first with topic reviewers only when relevant, and re-verify and close dead follow-ups each release.

notes.topic: review subagents write inside worktree
notes.correction: Tell review subagents to Write inside the worktree then cp with a single-line command, never heredocs, and collect results by completion notification not TaskOutput.

notes.topic: diff safety rule scope when rewriting
notes.correction: When rewriting a safety rule, diff old versus new scope clause by clause; dropped named entities and absolutes are suspect; mutation-test restored invariants.

notes.topic: reclaim runner workspace ownership before checkout
notes.correction: In every job on a self-hosted pool, chown the workspace via a throwaway container before actions/checkout, using the host's runner uid/gid, with if: always() cleanup.

notes.topic: schema success does not prove work
notes.correction: Read returned content before trusting success counters; keep default-refuted verifier prompts, re-derive from primary sources, and structurally check payload content, not just shape.
notes.repeat_signal: Second run: it returned a prose summary

notes.topic: scope permission entries by execution repo
notes.correction: Check per-repo call distribution before scoping allow entries; put cross-repo tool entries in global settings and insert at array head to avoid drift.

notes.topic: shell parse guards fail closed
notes.correction: Refuse syntax a shell-parsing guard doesn't model rather than partially modeling it; measure fail-closed cost on the corpus first and run cross-model adversarial pass on hook changes.

notes.topic: report silent tool fallbacks
notes.correction: Treat falling back from a broken tool to grep without saying so as a reportable event; score ablations on exit status or output validity, not invocation counts.
notes.repeat_signal: hit exit-1 three times in a row

notes.topic: disable ipv6 behind dropping fence
notes.correction: When a fence blackholes an address family, disable that family in the guest or REJECT instead of DROP, and prove it with ip -6 addr show.

notes.topic: slash skill needs first position
notes.correction: If a /skill mention does nothing, check token position before concluding the skill is missing or demoted; roster absence is a separate mechanism.
notes.repeat_signal: 1,829/1,829 mid-message skill tokens failed to expand

notes.topic: don't over-block skills on gated nitpicks
notes.correction: Separate unmitigated risks from nitpicks the permission system already gates; only the former justifies recommending a skill stay uninstalled.

notes.topic: never claim not installed from roster
notes.correction: Never say a skill is not installed on roster evidence alone; look in ~/.claude/skills, and treat mid-sentence /name as intent; keep hook context factual.
notes.repeat_signal: every one had the token mid-message

notes.topic: spot-check live failures before shim fix
notes.correction: Before shipping a shim or alias fix, sample real failing transcripts and check whether it would silently mask a different underlying problem.

notes.topic: retarget stacked PRs before parent merge
notes.correction: Retarget child PRs to main before squash-merging the bottom PR with --delete-branch; otherwise restore the base ref, reopen, retarget, and merge main in, never force-push.

notes.topic: verify merged config is actually live
notes.correction: After merging harness config, grep the live symlink target; if ff refuses, check for unmerged index entries and resolve memory backups from canonical files.

notes.topic: run sync install only from canonical checkout
notes.correction: Run sync.sh install only from ~/dotfiles; update a dirty main with fetch plus merge --ff-only; repoint dangling symlinks if a wrong-checkout install happened.

notes.topic: arbitrate from verdicts not synthesis
notes.correction: Orchestrator should arbitrate the final set from verdicts and designs directly; require synthesis to cite judge lines and have the critic check graft traceability.

notes.topic: avoid After= on draining services
notes.correction: A service that does work during stop must not carry After=/Before= against units that work may reload; use runtime preconditions and cancel the wedged job if needed.

notes.topic: test call order via real CLI
notes.correction: When ordering is the defect, drive the real CLI rather than calling units, and keep a mutation harness proving each load-bearing fix's test fails when broken.

notes.topic: label measured versus inferred claims
notes.correction: Before publishing, mark each claim measured or inferred, measure or label inferences, state sample caps, and never act on unverified negatives.

notes.topic: validate transcript detectors on real negatives
notes.correction: Validate detectors against real-corpus negatives, hand-classify hits, exclude sessions that worked on the component, and report unaudited counts as upper bounds.

notes.topic: keep test stubs on every PATH
notes.correction: Give runners that set child PATH a seam, point it at the stub dir, and assert stub call logs; never invent recognizer aliases to pass validators.

notes.topic: negative assertions pass vacuously on dead targets
notes.correction: When retiring a host, grep negative assertions for it separately; ask whether the check would still pass if the control broke.

notes.topic: validate probe before trusting absence
notes.correction: Probe a known-positive before concluding something is absent; get real symbol names from diffs, never pair multi-path ls with || echo, and read output not exit codes.

notes.topic: patch upstream against fresh clone
notes.correction: Build upstream contributions against a fresh clone of upstream HEAD, confirm target text verbatim, and cite the HEAD SHA; use local plugin copy only to find defects.

notes.topic: verify pushed tree from clean clone
notes.correction: After pushing, confirm expected files from a fresh shallow clone or check git status untracked files before commit; local green doesn't prove the pushed tree.

notes.topic: verify stale memory architecture claims
notes.correction: Treat old memory notes' architecture claims as hypotheses, spot-check the live code path, and correct the note in the same session if disproved.

notes.topic: verify delegated scope counts independently
notes.correction: Have delegated subagents independently compute scope counts and report discrepancies from the dispatcher's stated number rather than silently reconciling.

notes.topic: widening scanner view reopens channels
notes.correction: When widening a scanner to raw text, check every consumer of that variable and pass separate rawText and blankedText; keep bare-pattern scans on the sanitized view.

notes.topic: workflow arms obey relayed user request
notes.correction: When the latest user message isn't the workflow's task, run stages via the Agent tool or lean-reader agentType, and audit gh, tasks, and memory after runs.

notes.topic: no mktemp in worktree sessions
notes.correction: In worktree-isolated jobs, avoid mktemp command substitution; use a literal task-named /tmp path with mkdir -p for scratch directories.

notes.topic: never hand back wt-done rerun
notes.correction: Never tell the operator to re-run wt-done.sh from outside; run it inside and let wt-sweep dispose of the worktree with no human step.

notes.topic: quote yaml scalars containing hash
notes.correction: Quote YAML scalars containing ' #' or drop the hash, and verify by parsing with yaml.safe_load and checking run bodies for odd quote counts.
